description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for a web application, including functions for Markdown preview synchronization, Bootstrap tooltip initialization, alert message display, form change detection with unsaved changes warning, sticky element positioning, external link decoration, HTML decoding, and JSON data extraction.

methods.name: syncScrolling
methods.description: Synchronizes scrolling between linked elements, typically a textarea/input and a markdown preview div.

methods.name: initTootips
methods.description: Initializes Bootstrap tooltips on elements with data-bs-toggle='tooltip'.

methods.name: alertMessage
methods.description: Creates and appends a Bootstrap-styled alert message to a target container.

methods.name: decorateExternalLinks
methods.description: Adds an external link icon to links pointing outside the current origin.

methods.name: decodeHtml
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities into plain text.

methods.name: getJsonData
methods.description: Retrieves and parses JSON data embedded within an HTML element's innerText.
